title: cloud hosted skills door: repoint the eleven served sections of objectstack-data / objectstack-automation SKILL.md when the pin bump carries the router change
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Blocked-by: #36158

Filing gate: a condition of the maintainer's ruling on #34770 fork ① (option A), given in seat repo:objectstack#4's session 2026-11-24, verbatim 「34700  34770 同意」 on the seat's recommendation "①A — land as is, file a cloud card at the same time, priority not below #34770's, stating that the cloud pin bump to the framework version carrying PR #36158 repoints the hosted sections in the same change". Ruling record: the ruling comment on #34770.

## What

The hosted door serves eleven sections of `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` by exact heading (`packages/spec/scripts/skill-served-sections.json` in objectstack; 8,090 and 16,033 bytes on objectstack main). PR #36158 turns both files into routers: every served heading stays once, with shorter text, and the rest moves under unique headings in `references/*.md`. Without a repoint, the hosted door would serve 3,477 and 5,858 bytes after the pin bump — no start failure, silently shorter guidance for hosted customers' AI.

## Done when

- The cloud change that bumps the framework pin past PR #36158's merge also points each of the eleven served sections to the text's new location (or the router heading plus the moved reference), so the served byte counts do not fall.
- The bump and the repoint land in ONE cloud change, so hosted customers never see the shorter text.

## Who acts

The cloud lane (`repo:cloud`): transfer this card to the cloud repo or carry it there (cross-repo-coordination.md, the `repo:cloud` hand-over card). The objectstack side owes nothing more; PR #36158 is held to the order on #34770.

## Readings and gaps

- Read on objectstack: `packages/spec/scripts/skill-served-sections.json`, PR #36158's description, #34770 comment 7073349136 (fork ①).
- Not read: the cloud repo's hosted table (`published-refs.ts` per the dev report) and its pin mechanics — not readable from this seat.
